mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past three months signals an active monetary easing cycle, reducing the discount rate applied to future corporate earnings and increasing equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in less than 50% of instances when FEDFUNDS declines over 3 months, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payroll growth above 200k per month signals strong labor market demand, boosting consumer spending and corporate revenues, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX fails to generate positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of triggered instances, or the average return in triggered periods is not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in both residential investment (HOUST) and real personal consumption (RSAFS) indicates strong underlying demand momentum, which signals robust corporate revenue growth and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising HOUST and RSAFS fails to produce positive 60-day SPX returns in more than 55% of cases, or the interaction term's Rank IC is below 0.04 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 108.0 for two consecutive months signals weakening supply-side capacity, which reduces inflationary pressure and increases the likelihood of future monetary easing, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates negative or flat 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO falls below 108.0, or the signal's Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in CPIAUCSL above 252.0 in a single month signals accelerating inflation, prompting the Fed to maintain or raise rates, which increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in less than 55% of triggered instances, or the signal's Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous contraction in both GDP (GDPC1) and residential investment (HOUST) indicates a weakening demand environment, which increases the risk of recession and triggers a flight to safety, reducing equity valuations and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of declining GDPC1 and HOUST fails to produce negative 60-day SPX returns in more than 60% of cases, or the interaction term's Rank IC is below -0.04 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 3.5% while payroll growth (PAYEMS) exceeds 200k per month signals a tight labor market that pressures wages and inflation, prompting the Fed to tighten policy, which increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in less than 55% of triggered instances, or the interaction term's Rank IC is below -0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in industrial production (INDPRO) above 109.0 for two consecutive months signals strong supply-side resilience, which supports corporate profitability and reduces inflation risk, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX fails to generate positive 20-day returns in more than 55% of triggered instances, or the signal's Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
